title: Forest Pack
description: The textures pack add new textures for all sword, all tools (soon) in a forest style:)
body: Bring the essence of the forest into your battles! This mod/resource pack replaces swords in Minecraft with beautifully designed, forest-themed versions. Each sword is crafted to feel like it belongs in the wild, with natural textures, wooden handles, and leaf-inspired details. Perfect for players who want a more immersive and nature-inspired combat experience. Currently, only swords are updated, with more forest-themed items planned for the future!
